prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1321; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with a wrist fracture as the primary diagnosis. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash, and the findings are in keeping with what would be expected from this type of force. Radiographs and the clinical examination together clearly confirm the fracture, with tenderness, swelling, and reduced grip strength documented at initial evaluation. Immobilization was followed by a standard course of rehabilitation, including range-of-motion and strengthening exercises. Over the course of 21 visits, the patient's pain, mobility, and function improved steadily, and visit frequency tapered as recovery progressed. A remote history of a minor strain in the same area is noted in the chart; that episode resolved completely without lasting limitation and does not appear to bear on the current presentation. Billed services reflect the treatment delivered, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. At last review the patient had regained near-full range of motion and was discharged to home exercise with follow-up as needed.
